==== tluaCaptureGotoCycles.tlua (4 errors) ====
    // A backward goto re-runs everything between its label and itself, so an assignment inside that
    // span poisons capture narrowing to the goto's end -- the same rule a while body already gets.
    // Without it, a closure created after the nil guard could be called on the next pass, after the
    // reassignment and before the guard, and hand out the nil the narrowing promised away.
    
    declare function maybeName(): string | nil;
    declare function cond(): boolean;
    
    // A function declaration created inside the cycle reads the declared type.
    function declarationInCycle(): void
      local name = maybeName();
      local saved: (() => string) | nil = nil;
      ::top::
      name = maybeName();
      if saved ~= nil then
        local s: string = saved();
      end
      if name == nil then
        name = "anon";
      end
      function greet(): string
        return name;              // error: the goto re-opens the nil arm
        ~~~~~~
!!! error TLUA2322: Type 'string | nil' is not assignable to type 'string'.
!!! error TLUA2322:   Type 'nil' is not assignable to type 'string'.
      end
      saved = greet;
      if cond() then
        goto top;
      end
    end
    
    // A function expression gets the same suppression.
    function expressionInCycle(): void
      local name = maybeName();
      local saved: (() => string) | nil = nil;
      ::top::
      name = maybeName();
      if saved ~= nil then
        local s: string = saved();
      end
      if name == nil then
        name = "anon";
      end
      saved = function(): string
        return name;              // error: same cycle, same rule
        ~~~~~~
!!! error TLUA2322: Type 'string | nil' is not assignable to type 'string'.
!!! error TLUA2322:   Type 'nil' is not assignable to type 'string'.
      end;
      if cond() then
        goto top;
      end
    end
    
    // The syntactic loop keeps its own, older extension.
    function whileLoop(): void
      local name = maybeName();
      local saved: (() => string) | nil = nil;
      while cond() do
        name = maybeName();
        if name == nil then
          name = "anon";
        end
        saved = function(): string
          return name;            // error: the loop body extension
          ~~~~~~
!!! error TLUA2322: Type 'string | nil' is not assignable to type 'string'.
!!! error TLUA2322:   Type 'nil' is not assignable to type 'string'.
        end;
      end
    end
    
    // A local declared inside the cycle is a fresh binding on every pass: the one a closure
    // captured is never assigned again, so its narrowing stands.
    function freshBindingInCycle(): void
      local saved: (() => string) | nil = nil;
      ::top::
      local name = maybeName();
      if saved ~= nil then
        local s: string = saved();
      end
      if name == nil then
        name = "anon";
      end
      saved = function(): string
        return name;              // fine: this pass's binding is done being assigned
      end;
      if cond() then
        goto top;
      end
    end
    
    // A forward goto re-enters nothing, so it suppresses nothing.
    function forwardOnly(): void
      local name = maybeName();
      if cond() then
        goto done;
      end
      if name == nil then
        name = "anon";
      end
      function g(): string
        return name;              // fine: only reachable through the guard
      end
      ::done::
    end
    
    // A same-named label in a block the goto cannot see does not stand in for the real target:
    // the goto resolves to the outer ::top::, whose cycle re-runs the assignment.
    function shadowedLabel(): void
      if cond() then
        ::top::                  // scoped to this then-block; invisible to the goto below
      end
      local name = maybeName();
      local saved: (() => string) | nil = nil;
      ::top::
      name = maybeName();
      if saved ~= nil then
        local s: string = saved();
      end
      if name == nil then
        name = "anon";
      end
      saved = function(): string
        return name;             // error: the outer label's cycle re-opens the nil arm
        ~~~~~~
!!! error TLUA2322: Type 'string | nil' is not assignable to type 'string'.
!!! error TLUA2322:   Type 'nil' is not assignable to type 'string'.
      end;
      if cond() then
        goto top;
      end
    end
    
    // Assignments wholly before the label are not re-run by the jump.
    function beforeLabel(): void
      local name = maybeName();
      if name == nil then
        name = "anon";
      end
      local saved: (() => string) | nil = nil;
      ::top::
      saved = function(): string
        return name;              // fine: the cycle never assigns name
      end;
      if cond() then
        goto top;
      end
    end
